title: Resident small exact relation matrices
objective: Using the authentic cubic class-group profiler, implement a same-source resident packed exact-relation matrix capability that fuses HNF support, bounded row-deletion trials, and retained-rank publication while preserving canonical HNF/source-row support, exact fallback, proof semantics, cancellation, and resource bounds; benchmark end-to-end and leave shared registrations to integration.

handoff.summary: Adds an independently exact, bounded resident relation-matrix capability with canonical FLINT HNF, verified unimodular source transform, source-row support, retained rank, stable candidate deletion, same-source generated JavaScript, and an ordinary CPython oracle/cancellation path. Captured 4027 and 5448 cubic selector inputs agree with the current FLINT selector, including support and deletion schedule; proof-carrying whole cubic projections reproduce exact scalars and presentation digests. A nine-sample O2 Linux x64 run improves the hard unconditional 4027 scalar by 9.82 percent (selector 57.78 ms to 24.16 ms), with the four 588/5448 neighbors between -1.50 and +1.82 percent.
risks: The contract remains active because a fresh pnpm test:native run passed all correctness, compiler, FFI, and migration stages but its final unrelated dense QQ public-surface timing gate measured select_rows_300, select_columns_300, and stack_300x300 at about 35 ms against 15 ms budgets. No passing native receipt is claimed.

Shared package ownership and production-kernel registration are deliberately absent under the lane claims, so pnpm architecture:check and pnpm test:changed stop at the expected missing matrix-native-kernels package owner until integration adds the documented shared entries.

GP/PARI, Sage, and Magma executables were unavailable on this Linux x64 host; the fresh differentials are CPython, generated JavaScript, current FLINT HNF/selector behavior, and the existing pinned cubic scalar/proof fixtures.
The optimizer-packed-containers dependency is integration ordering only; this implementation consumes no API from that lane.
next_steps: Integration lane: apply the documented narrow _select_cubic_relation_candidates replacement and retain its empty-input guard and exception policy.

Integration lane: add class_group_hnf.py to architecture/package-graph.json and pyrightconfig.json, add the production witness to architecture/native-kernels.json, classify its WebAssembly capability and regenerate the coverage/capability receipts, and add the benchmark package script exactly as documented in RESIDENT-HNF.md.

After shared registration, rerun pnpm architecture:check, pnpm test:changed, the pinned ten-field cubic smoke corpus, the stratified 100-field corpus, and the clean-host pnpm test:native gate; collect Linux arm64, Windows x64 fallback, and macOS arm64 receipts.
